verdict.rationale: First-party marketing says a 'Payroll AI' collects time and attendance data, spots inconsistencies, and texts the admin updates. That is a narrow form of AI-generated insight drawn from the user's own data. Beyond this one claim there is no evidence of broader AI insights or suggestions (e.g., cost trends or recommendations), and the payroll reports in docs-18 are not described as AI-generated. Missing for 10: AI insights beyond time-and-attendance anomaly flagging, in-product suggestion or recommendation surfaces, detailed docs on how the AI works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
